js: (async () => { const s = ms => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms)); const G = window.G, P = G.player, POD = G.X.PODCAST; localStorage.removeItem('notgta.podcast'); POD.setAn(false, true); POD.testFolgen([{ title: 'Stille (Test, nur Probe)', file: 'podcast-stille.mp3', duration: 6, src: 'tools/proben/podcast-stille.mp3' }]); const ok = c => c && c.userData && !c.userData.bike && !c.userData.heli && !c.userData.boat && !c.userData.cannon && !c.userData.police && !c.userData.ambulance && c.userData.mode !== 'wreck'; if (P.car) G.toggleCar(); let c = G.cars.filter(c => ok(c) && c.userData.mode === 'parked').sort((a, b) => a.position.distanceTo(P.pos) - b.position.distanceTo(P.pos))[0]; if (!c) c = G.cars.filter(c => ok(c) && c.userData.mode === 'ai').sort((a, b) => a.position.distanceTo(P.pos) - b.position.distanceTo(P.pos))[0]; if (!c) return 'kein Auto'; P.pos.set(c.position.x + 0.5, c.position.y, c.position.z); if (P.mesh) P.mesh.position.copy(P.pos); G.toggleCar(); P.wanted = 0; await s(500); for (let i = 0; i < 6 && !POD.an; i++) { window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keydown', { code: 'KeyU' })); window.dispatchEvent(new KeyboardEvent('keyup', { code: 'KeyU' })); await s(400); } await s(800); return JSON.stringify({ auto: !!P.car, an: POD.an, modus: POD.modus, src: POD.src, gefiltert: POD.gefiltert, blockiert: POD.blockiert, band: document.getElementById('radioband').textContent, radio: G.X.RADIO.playing }); })()
expect: (() => { const POD = window.G.X.PODCAST; return POD.an && POD.modus === 'auto' && POD.src.includes('podcast-stille') && document.getElementById('radioband').textContent.includes('Podcast') && window.G.X.RADIO.playing === -1; })()

js: (async () => { const s = ms => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms)); const G = window.G, P = G.player, POD = G.X.PODCAST; if (P.car) G.toggleCar(); await s(500); const r = G.cars.filter(c => c.userData && c.userData.bike && !c.userData.moto && c.userData.mode !== 'wreck').sort((a, b) => a.position.distanceTo(P.pos) - b.position.distanceTo(P.pos))[0]; if (r) { P.pos.set(r.position.x + 0.4, r.position.y, r.position.z); if (P.mesh) P.mesh.position.copy(P.pos); G.toggleCar(); } await s(900); return JSON.stringify({ rad: !!(P.car && P.car.userData.bike), an: POD.an, modus: POD.modus, src: POD.src, gefiltert: POD.gefiltert, band: document.getElementById('podband').textContent }); })()
expect: (() => { const POD = window.G.X.PODCAST, P = window.G.player; return POD.an && POD.modus === 'headset' && !POD.gefiltert && POD.src.includes('podcast-stille') && (!P.car || P.car.userData.bike); })()
